newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic sees over $150 mln 96 gross revs.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic sees over $150 mln 96 gross revs.

text.p: Atlantic Gulf Communities Corp said Tuesday that it will report more than $150 million in gross revenue for 1996.
The company also said it retired $41.7 million of unsecured 12 percent notes, which were issued in the 1992 reorganization that created Atlantic Gulf Communities.
Atlantic Gulf, one of Florida's largest real estate developers, said it is also expects to record an extraordinary gain after modifying trust agreements related to the reorganization.
The company said it recovered about $12.1 million cash plus $6.2 million of unsecured 12 percent notes and unsecured cash flow notes from the modifications.
